# ReelSaid — Instagram Reels Transcript API

> Every Reel, in Words. Turn public Instagram Reels and video posts into original-language transcripts, opening hooks, timestamped words, and SRT or WebVTT with Whisper Large-v3.

Use ReelSaid for Instagram video-to-text, subtitle generation, creator research, and public account monitoring. The Apify Actor is `aimansour/reelsaid`.

## Choose the right interface

- Use Apify MCP or the native Apify run API for multiple links, public profiles, carousels, datasets, and continuation. For MCP, call `fetch-actor-details`, `call-actor` with an explicit source, then `get-dataset-items` with the returned dataset ID.
- Use authenticated JSON `POST /` at `https://aimansour--reelsaid.apify.actor/` for one video. Read `rows[0]` and `summary`. Standby includes requested subtitles inline.
- Pass `language: "auto"` for automatic language detection. Preserve the original spoken language. Set `wordLevelTimestamps: true` when a workflow needs individual words.

## Tool and examples

- [Actor listing and quickstart](https://apify.com/aimansour/reelsaid)
- [Input fields](https://apify.com/aimansour/reelsaid/input-schema)
- [API recipes and response fields](https://github.com/aimansour/reelsaid/blob/main/examples/api/README.md)
- [Standby request JSON](https://github.com/aimansour/reelsaid/blob/main/examples/api/standby.json)
- [Single Reel JSON](https://github.com/aimansour/reelsaid/blob/main/examples/api/reel.json)
- [Profile JSON](https://github.com/aimansour/reelsaid/blob/main/examples/api/profile.json)
- [Dataset JSON](https://github.com/aimansour/reelsaid/blob/main/examples/api/dataset.json)
- [Example output](https://github.com/aimansour/reelsaid/blob/main/examples/api/output.json)
- [Apify MCP setup](https://docs.apify.com/agents/quickstart)

Read `status`, `errorCode`, and `retryable` for each row. Use `transcript` for full text, `segments` for timed text, and `hook.text` for available speech in the opening three seconds. The post caption is `metadata.caption`. Native runs keep continuation in the `SUMMARY` record and return subtitle URLs. Native and Standby result history is separate. Reuse a result within the same interface or use `forceRefresh` for a fresh transcript.
